mentions.name: Java single-user blogging CMS/SSG server
mentions.description: A single-user blogging CMS/server written in Java that acts as a static site generator while providing a GUI for publishing and reading. It speaks indie web protocols, implementing webmentions (including vouch, private mentions, and salmentions) and possibly IndieAuth. It aims to sit between Bearblog and Miniflux, with Java chosen for long-term stability and maintainability.
mentions.problem: Solves the author's annoyances with Hugo and static site generators in general.
mentions.source_excerpt: A single-user blogging CMS/server that acts as static site generator while having a GUI for publishing/reading and that speaks some indie web protocols. I'm implementing webmentions (vouch, private mentions, salmentions) and maybe indie auth.
mentions.author: sav_m
